metadata.description: Skills, agents and extensions for GitHub Copilot CLI (the Claude Code marketplace is .claude-plugin/marketplace.json).

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: /code-review skill: reviews the branch diff, or a PR, branch, commit range or path, for correctness bugs and broken repository rules. An effort level (low to max) sets how many finder subagents explore, and a verifier subagent checks each candidate before it is reported. --fix applies findings, --comment posts them to the PR.

plugins.name: independent-review
plugins.description: independent-reviewer agent: reviews a change in a context separate from the one that wrote it, verifies by running the build and tests itself, and reports correctness problems with evidence. Does not edit code.

plugins.name: m365
plugins.description: /m365: ask Microsoft 365 Copilot from the session through UI Automation, with the conversation so far, response profiles (fixed instructions, JSON answers) and text files attached; /m365-raw sends the question alone. No model call on the Copilot CLI side. Windows only.

plugins.name: session-export
plugins.description: /export and /export-usage: write the session to Markdown in the same format as Copilot CLI /export file, optionally with per-response tokens and AI credits. No model call. /export is for hosts without the built-in one (the CLI's own /export takes precedence).
